first.rationale:
The competitor's entry pricing makes promotional_pricing the emotionally obvious response, but the single memory supporting it (memory_73) carries an explicit self-reported defect: the readout pooled two cohorts after a mid-test redefinition. That caveat travelled with the memory and must not be dropped now that the memory is being used to justify a decision. Discount-led acquisition is also the direction most likely to buy short-term volume at the cost of the stated objective, sustainable long-term qualified revenue, so it deserves the most scrutiny rather than the least. I am spending one verification pull on memory_73 precisely because it is the tempting option and the one whose evidence is known to be weakest; if the archive shows the lift survives cohort separation, promotional_pricing becomes live again, and if it does not, a large discount program was nearly launched on a pooled artifact.

The second pull goes to memory_86 (onboarding shortening) because it is the memory my intended action actually rests on, and unverified support for the action I plan to take is worth more than support for actions I plan to decline. memory_86 and memory_31 point the same way from independent tests, and the two observed declines are causally ordered: onboarding completion (-4%) sits upstream of activation (-6%), so a share of the activation drop is plausibly a downstream symptom rather than an independent problem. Fixing the upstream constriction is the higher-leverage single slot, and unlike discounting it improves the quality of accounts entering the funnel rather than degrading it.

Caveats I am carrying forward rather than resolving: memory_31 and memory_86 are from days 12 and 52, and the funnel that produced them predates the competitive shift, so their effect sizes may not transfer intact. memory_91 (activation messaging) remains a strong fallback and becomes the better choice if verification shows the onboarding regression is not the driver. memory_44 (enterprise sales-assist) targets a segment that is not the one under attack, so it is deferred, not rejected. Standard experiment scale rather than broad rollout, because the supporting evidence is solid but stale and I want a fresh read before committing the funnel.
